title: Retriv at BLP-2025 Task 1: A Transformer Ensemble and Multi-Task Learning Approach for Bangla Hate Speech Identification
reasoning: The paper benchmarks systems on their ability to classify 'Religious Hate' as a specific category of fine-grained hate speech in the Bangla language. It provides quantitative performance metrics (precision, recall, etc.) for how well models identify hostility directed at religious groups.
